title: Grade-Commitment Mismatch (GCM-v1) (v2.8)
description: X-04/D5 dispute evidence: the recipient, on eventually reading an availability-grade message, finds the actual content_class differs from what the grade commitment binds, and REVEALS the envelope's true (salt, content_class). Verification (the I-D, Grade-Commitment Mismatch): recompute the commitment from the reveal against the pinned BW-ORG version — the GCM is a valid rebuttal iff EITHER the recomputation differs from the sealed grade_commitment (the commitment never bound the actual envelope) OR it matches but the revealed class's declared grade is not availability (a truthfully-committed non-availability class obtained availability treatment). A GCM whose reveal matches AND whose class IS availability-declared proves nothing and is REJECTED (LINT-BND-26). The availability DE remains FINAL at authenticated S2; a valid GCM REBUTS it in dispute — it does not retract it (no terminal-outcome change; EP carriage is the OPTIONAL disputes[] array). TODO(legal): the Article 43(2) rebuttable-presumption clause awaits external counsel (DESIGN_DECISIONS.md D5).

event.description: The read/access event at which the mismatch was discovered (EN 319 522-1); the GCM is supplementary dispute evidence, never a terminal outcome.

mid.description: The member who read the content and asserts the mismatch.

reveal.description: The envelope's true (salt, content_class) — the salt travels only in the E2EE envelope, so both endpoints hold it (TS grade-commitment reveal).

salt.description: DR-03: EXACTLY 16 bytes = 32 lowercase hex characters. The former `^[a-f0-9]{2,128}$` admitted 1..64 bytes AND odd lengths; an odd-length salt was schema-valid and raised an uncaught ValueError inside the cross-document validator — a denial of validation, not a lint failure.

grade_commitment.description: The DISPUTED sealed commitment, echoed from the SE/DE (bundle-checked equal, LINT-BND-26).

rdp_id.description: Sealed by RDP(in) — the provider of the recipient asserting the mismatch.

envelope_hash.description: DR-03: the transmitted-octet commitment of the DISPUTED message — the dispute is bound to specific bytes, not merely to a message_id (LINT-GCM-02).
